decisions.mark: concludes that the rule is ASYMMETRIC — the stated tiers REPLACE one another while the discovered layers ACCUMULATE and survive whatever anyone states
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "target facts (tier 3) and ecosystem signatures (tier 4) accumulate, and no stated tier removes them. Heuristics (tier 5) are the only layer a stated value displaces." and "`resolved = (tier1 or tier2 or tier5) ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4`. In plain terms, you can correct clew's guesses, but you cannot un-discover a fact." | WHY: The answer says stated tiers replace each other (flag replaces declared, section replaces section) while discovered tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and cannot be removed by anything stated. || QUOTE: "target facts (tier 3) and ecosystem signatures (tier 4) accumulate, and no stated tier removes them. Heuristics (tier 5) are the only layer a stated value displaces." | WHY: The answer states that stated tiers replace one another (flag replaces declared, section replaces section) while discovered tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and survive any stated value, with the formula `(tier1 or tier2 or tier5) ∪ tier3 ∪ tier4`. || QUOTE: "target facts (tier 3) and ecosystem signatures (tier 4) accumulate, and no stated tier removes them.
